birth.note: Approximated based on his death year (874 H) and the statement that he lived for about 100 years.

death.note: Died in Ramadan or Shawwal. He lived for about 100 years. This information was provided to al-Sakhāwī by some Moroccans.

person.note: マグリブの人々から高徳と善行により広く知られた。
アハマド・ブン・アル＝ハサン・アル＝グマーリー・アル＝アロースィー。マグリブ全域で、その高徳と善行により広く知られた人物。およそ100歳まで生きた。874年のラマダーンまたはシャウワールに死去した。この情報は一部のマグリブ人から私に伝えられた。

Aḥmad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ghumārī al-ʿArūsī. He was widely renowned throughout the entire Maghrib for his piety and goodness. He lived for about a hundred years. He died in Ramadan or Shawwal of the year 874 AH. This information was conveyed to me by some Moroccans.
